title: E-FRC-0152: steering needs a schedule in which every line meets every other, and no knit that precesses one...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0152 in the gauge arena: steering needs a schedule in which every line meets every other, and no knit that precesses one partition by a symmetry of the box has one: the color turn weave's couples reach 12 of 66 pairs and no power of any of the 1,152 symmetries reaches more than 36, while a round robin folded into the 24-beat palindrome reaches all 66, keeps CPT, and with lone steering leaves the vacuum exactly as it was.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
